notes/6.-virtualization-and-virtual-mach.title: 6. Virtualization and Virtual Machines
notes/6.-virtualization-and-virtual-mach.description: Virtualization is technology that creates a virtual version of physical infrastructure, such as servers, storage, and networks.A hypervisor is the abstraction layer that sits between the physical computer and the VM. It distributes resources across VMs and keeps each VM separate to simulate VM as a separate physical computer. Type 1 - Bare Metal Oracle VM Server Type 2 - Hosted VirtualBox Advantage of Virtual Machines Portability - VMs are easily relocatable throughout the network Scalability - resources can be adjusted as needed Testing Environments - easy to deploy and delete

notes/nist-csf-drivers.html.title: NIST CSF Drivers
notes/nist-csf-drivers.html.description:
Date: Sep 16, 2025 Tags: NIST CSFLaws mandates organizations to adopt structured cybersecurity frameworks to meet legal obligations.US federal law that aims to improve cybersecurity through public-private partnership, enhance research and development, and promote workforce education and awareness. Also known as Public Law No: 113-274Titled Improving Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity, issued on Feb 2013 due to increasing cyber threats to critical infrastructure. It focuses on three areas: information sharing privacy adoption of cybersecurity practices National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) was directed to develop a cybersecurity framework from existing voluntary consensus standards and industry best practices. Titled Strengthening the Cybersecurity of Federal Networks and Critical Infrastructure, issued on May 2017. Mandates the framework for all government agencies Still voluntary for everyone else Requires agencies to: Inventory computer systems Identify and provide appropriate security protections Develop, document, and implement agency-wide information security program Intended to reduce cracking of computer systems and to address federal computer-related offenses. Mainly for financial and government computer systems but later include civilians' computer and even cellphones.Extended the restrictions on wire taps and other electronic communications in transit Protects stored electronic communication Added pen/traps provisions that permits tracking of telephone communications (with court order)Now covers personal identifiable information (PII) Restrict disclosure Increase right of access to agency records Grant individuals the right to seek amendment Establish a code of fair information practices
[Executive Order on Strengthening the Cybersecurity of Federal Networks and Critical Infrastructure | CISA]

projects/ubuntu-server-setup.html.title: Ubuntu Server Setup
projects/ubuntu-server-setup.html.description:
Update repositories with
sudo apt updateInstall Virtualbox with
sudo apt install virtualbox virtualbox-ext-pack virtualbox-guest-additions-iso -yAcquire Windows Server 2022 ISO from microsoft official website. Since I already have a copy, I just hosted in on a webserver and download it on the ubuntu machine
“Pasted image 20250902074046.png” could not be found.# Create the VM
VBoxManage createvm --name "WinServer" --ostype "Windows2022_64" --register # Configure basic settings with bridged networking
VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --memory 2048 --vram 128 --cpus 2 --firmware efi
VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --nic1 bridged --bridgeadapter1 wlan0 --nictype1 82540EM
VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --audio-driver none --usb off --usbehci off # Create virtual disk
VBoxManage createmedium disk --filename "WinServer.vdi" --size 51200 # Attach storage controller and disk
VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "SATA Controller" --add sata --controller IntelAhci
VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "SATA Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type hdd --medium "WinServer.vdi"
VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "IDE Controller" --add ide
VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "IDE Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type dvddrive --medium /usr/share/virtualbox/VBoxGuestAdditions.iso # Attach ISO for installation
VBoxManage storagectl "WinServer" --name "IDE Controller" --add ide
VBoxManage storageattach "WinServer" --storagectl "IDE Controller" --port 0 --device 0 --type dvddrive --medium "SERVER_EVAL_x64FRE_en-us.iso" # Enable RDP
VBoxManage modifyvm "WinServer" --vrde on --vrdeport 3389

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
